title: •Blizzard Scout 1
caption: •Blizzard Scout 1 (V)
game_text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May move as a ‘react.’ During battle, if with your piloted AT-AT, may cancel game text of an opponent’s character present.
lore: *Enclosed* All Terrain Scout Transport (AT-ST). Provides flanking support to the AT-ATs of Blizzard Force. Modified for cold weather combat.

notes: Unique (•). Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column: one yellow square with a black pilot figure = Permanent Pilot → 'permanent-pilot'. Slip deploy 3 / forfeit 5 (same as printed). Curly single quotes ‘react.’ (period inside) and curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Lore corrected from the scan: 'Enclosed' is printed in bold (keyword) → *Enclosed*. Only one Decipher face exists on the wiki, Hoth-D-blizzardscout1.gif (745×1039), whose corner is tagged D-E1 although the wiki page is 'printed' (no (Original)/(Errata) pages) and its game text matches the printed card — used. Modern: V0-D-blizzardscout1.gif (745) used; VB2 -pre and non-pre (350) also downloaded. Copyright 1996 legible on the 745 face.
